EFI and add-ons

Up to 16 more gauges, no new holes

BIM expansion modules plug into RTX, HDX, VHX and VFD3 systems to add specialty readings, or read straight from your engine computer, without cutting the dash or hanging pods.

See all modulesWatch the BIM video

Check your control box. BIM modules work with current RTX, HDX, VHX, VFD3 and RET control boxes that have a black plastic housing. Older metal-housing control boxes aren't compatible.

Expansion modules

  • Bridge module for EFI systemsBIM-EFI-1→
  • OBD-II / CAN interfaceBIM-01-2→
  • FAST XFI interfaceBIM-01-2-FAST→
  • MSD Atomic EFI TBI interfaceBIM-01-2-MSD→
  • J-1939 CAN interfaceBIM-01-2-J1939→
  • GPS speed and compass senderGPS-50-2→
  • RGB lighting controlBIM-RGB→
  • Pressure moduleBIM-03-2→
  • Temperature moduleBIM-04-2→
  • Voltage and current moduleBIM-05-1→
  • EGT and head temperature moduleBIM-12-2→
  • Wideband air/fuel moduleBIM-13-2→
  • Clock moduleBIM-16-1→
  • Compass with outside temperatureBIM-17-2→
  • Quad air pressure moduleBIM-19-2→
  • Tire pressure monitoring (TPMS)BIM-22-3→
